quiz.prompt: Kaiserlich und königlich (k. u. k.) refers to…

goodToKnow: Kaiserlich means imperial: die kaiserliche Familie, das kaiserliche Wien. Der Kaiser comes from Latin Caesar, like Russian tsar. Germany had Kaiser from 1871 until Wilhelm II abdicated in 1918, and Austria until 1918 too; the Habsburg empire was known as k. u. k. (kaiserlich und königlich), imperial and royal. Kaiserwetter means glorious sunny weather, supposedly because the emperor always had sunshine at public events.
